assistant|slow_cooker_recipe_recommendat: Suggested slow cooker recipes across categories: chili con carne, pulled pork, beef stew, Korean BBQ beef, Indian butter chicken, Mexican chicken tacos, lentil curry, roasted vegetable stew, black bean chili, mac and cheese, chicken and dumplings, pot roast, Greek chicken, Jamaican jerk chicken, breakfast casserole
assistant|slow_cooker_yogurt_recipe: Provided slow cooker yogurt recipe: 1/2 gallon milk heated to 180-185°F, cooled to 110-120°F, add 1/4 cup plain yogurt with live cultures, incubate 8-12 hours, chill and store
assistant|yogurt_thermometer_advice: Advised that a thermometer is highly recommended for yogurt making to reach 180-185°F for killing bacteria and denaturing proteins; without one, results may be inconsistent
assistant|vegetarian_vegan_slow_cooker_r: Suggested vegetarian/vegan slow cooker recipes: lentil curry, roasted vegetable stew, black bean chili, eggplant parmesan, butternut squash risotto, vegan chili, quinoa and black bean bowl, lentil and mushroom stew, vegan mac and cheese, chickpea and spinach curry
assistant|vegan_yogurt_alternatives: Listed vegan yogurt bases: soy, coconut, almond, cashew, oat, rice, hemp, flax, with brands like Silk, So Delicious, Coconut Bliss, Coyo, Almond Breeze, Oatly, Rice Dream, Good Karma, Elmhurst 1925
assistant|yogurt_flavorings_sweeteners: Suggested yogurt flavorings (vanilla, cinnamon, fruit, nutmeg, ginger, lemon, cocoa), sweeteners (honey, maple syrup, coconut sugar, date syrup, monk fruit, stevia), and add-ins (granola, nuts, seeds, cocoa nibs, dried fruit)
assistant|cashew_soaking_blending_tips: Advised soaking 1 cup cashews 4+ hours or overnight, draining and rinsing, blending with 1/2 cup water until smooth, then straining; adjust cashew-to-water ratio and blending time for desired thickness
assistant|cashew_straining_options: Compared straining tools for cashew mixture: cheesecloth (high filtration, messy), nut milk bag (effective, pricey), fine-mesh sieve (convenient, may leave grainy texture)
